metadata.description: jakub's Claude Code marketplace - plugins and skill bundles.

plugins.name: gripe
plugins.description: A local complaint log for coding agents: friction gets filed as it happens, observed or self-reported, into one SQLite file a model summarises for the user later.

plugins.name: flow
plugins.description: The prep → issue → land development pipeline: stage skills, hooks, cross-family delegation, and the engineering charter.

plugins.name: grill
plugins.description: Relentless design interrogation plus the domain-model doc discipline it feeds: grill-with-docs, grilling, domain-modeling. Vendored from Matt Pocock's skills (MIT).

plugins.name: unslop
plugins.description: Two writing skills vendored from Lauren Tan's pstack (MIT): unslop cuts AI tells from any writing, technical-writing is the layered standard for docs a reader comes back to. Both model-invocable, no hooks.

plugins.name: plans
plugins.description: Three skills for HTML output. show picks a Sketch in chat, an Inline render or a published Document for each visual. doc writes plan, review, walkthrough and report pages on a vendored, patched html-plan runtime. publish uploads, render-checks and deletes HTML, images and video through the plans CLI and a self-hosted plansd server.
